title: Newly Renovated! Vibrant Exciting Nash Condo+ Pool
description:
Open your private front doorand step into CHIC AND VIBRANT Condo!  

This vibrant, stylish, and NEWLY-RENOVATED space is the perfect "home base" for any Nashville visiter. Walking distance from the BEST of what Nashville has to offer: 12th South, Melrose, Downtown, Belmont, + Vandy. An inexpensive $6 Lyft/Uber ride to the rest of the best!

5 mins - Downtown Nash (Titans/Preds/Broadway/Ryman)
4 mins - Vandy/Belmont
3 mins - Grocery store
2 mins - Great food
1 min - Liquor store right next door!

The space
We’re proud Airbnb Super Hosts and feel incredibly grateful to have earned over 4,000 5-star reviews across our 9 beautiful Nashville condos! If you’re traveling with a group, you’ll be happy to know we have 5 condos located on the same floor in this building, making it easy to stay close while enjoying your own space. We’d love the opportunity to host you!

THE CONDO:
We love converting ordinary places into spectacular spaces… and sharing them with our guests. With 4,000+ amazing reviews across our properties, you can book with confidence. This condo was renovated specifically to inspire happiness and creativity. It is modern, colorful, playful, clean, and completely unique.

Not only is this fantastic condo a perfect place to call “home base“ during your stay in Nashville, but it is also THOROUGHLY-CLEANED, SANITIZED, and is a SPECTACULAR SPACE for staycations, a work-from-home alternative, or for small families.

Located just over 1 mile from the core of downtown Nashville, this top-floor, vibrant condo has everything you need and more. 

AMMENITIES INCLUDE:
A full-size "studio" kitchen equipped with all amenities
A brand new stylized bathroom with a customized walk-in shower
A full Kureg coffee bar (equipped with everything you need for your morning cup of coffee!)
A cozy and comfy queen size bed nestled against a modern marble wall
An outdoor pool for those hot Nashville summer days
Wifi 
FREE parking

LOCATION: 
Our condo is located on the top floor of a building called ‘Studio 1’ and just over 1 mile from the core of downtown Nashville. It is central to just about everything and just a short distance to all of the many great neighborhoods in town (including walking distance to the 12th South and Melrose neighborhoods. It is a wonderful place to call “home base” while in Nashville!

THE POOL:
We have a fantastic pool. Unfortunately, the pool is only open for your enjoyment late-Spring though late-Summer. It typically closes around Labor Day...and is sometimes open later in the year if the weather is nice!

GUEST ACCESS:
Guests will be able to access the free parking onsite, all common areas, the pool, the laundry room, etc. Pretty much everything!
